cards.headline:
ChatGPT Dots now pick
the best model on their own
cards.body: With GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra, ChatGPT Dots will automatically pick the best AI model for each task.

blocks.x: OpenAI is making ChatGPT Dots smarter with GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra, allowing them to automatically pick the best AI model for each task.
